summary: Consume Goal governance proposals through Planfile

delivery.outcome: Koru validates Goal proposals, creates or reuses a deduplicated automatic Planfile remediation ticket and exposes the explicit goal-remediation CLI boundary.
nonGoals: Do not accept executor, queue, approval or transport fields from the proposal
Do not execute the created ticket in the proposal intake command
Do not bypass Koru's existing queue leases, retry limits or governance handoff
Do not modify Goal or Planfile source repositories

architecture.decision: Keep proposal validation and Planfile ticket creation in Koru. Use Planfile's strict TicketProposalV1 contract, then map only safe fields into create_nl_task while Koru selects the executor and queue policy.
architecture.rollback: Remove the dispatcher entry and consumer module; existing Koru goal supervision remains available.

commands: python -m ruff check src/koru/cli.py src/koru/cli_goal_remediation.py tests/test_cli.py tests/test_goal_remediation.py
validation.evidence: Focused consumer and supervisor checks plus managed repository gates
